title: Specialization View
description: A derived, version-pinned consumer of the first-order catalog (CR-DEA-BC-04; TAXONOMY.md section 4). Views reference parents by id; they never modify or replace L1 entries.

level.description: L2 enterprise/domain or L3 industry/sector view (TAXONOMY.md section 4).

catalog_baseline.description: The catalog set the view was built against (version pinning, D3). Compatibility is stated, never enforced upward.

parent.description: A canonical capability id (dea:capability-...) or a parent specialization id (SPEC-NNN). Referential integrity checked by CI.

name.description: Industry vocabulary permitted below L1 (TAXONOMY.md section 1 rule 5 governs L1 only).

definition_delta.description: What the sector narrows or adds relative to the parent definition.

sources.description: Sector references (evidence, not authority: EVIDENCE.md stance).

ecf_note.description: Industry-specific participation note. Never contradicts the parent mapping (D6).

inherited.description: Canonical capability ids the view adopts unchanged (inheritance only, no delta).

reason.description: Why the candidate specialization fails (typically the business-object test, D7).

ecfConformance.description: ECF Conformance Gate manifest inherited from the catalog baseline (CR-ECF-CG-001..003). The view declares its conformance by inheritance. Optional at schema level; scripts/check_ecf_conformance.py enforces presence on views.
